This hearing can be viewed via live stream on the Assembly's website at https://www.assembly.ca.gov/schedules-publications/todays-events

We advise the public to monitor the committee website for updates.  Please contact the Assembly Budget Committee at 916-319-2099 if you have any questions or need assistance.
